title: VoiceTelephonyDefinition - Tooling API
description: Represents the org-level voice telephony configuration for Agentforce Contact Center, including the dialing prefix, dialing region, default caller ID, and pre-dial flow used when placing outbound calls. This object is available in API version 68.0 and later.

DefaultCallerIdentifier.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
DefaultCallerIdentifier.description: Caller ID displayed on outbound calls placed with this configuration.

Description.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Description.description: Purpose and scope of the voice telephony configuration.

DeveloperName.description: Unique name of the object in the API.

DialingPrefix.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
DialingPrefix.description: Dialing prefix prepended to outbound phone numbers for the telephony configuration.

DialingRegion.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
DialingRegion.description: Dialing region associated with the telephony configuration, used to determine routing and number formatting.

Language.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update

MasterLabel.description: User interface name of the voice telephony configuration.

PreDialFlowId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
PreDialFlowId.description: ID of the flow executed before an outbound call is placed using the voice telephony configuration. This field is a relationship field.

special_access_rules: To access this object, enable Agentforce Contact Center Admin (Salesforce Voice) permission set.
